newsitem.title: USA: US Jan durables up, hint at manufacturing strength.
newsitem.headline: US Jan durables up, hint at manufacturing strength.

text.p: U.S. durable goods orders jumped a higher-than-expected 3.6 percent in January, suggesting the manufacturing sector is firm and likely to stay strong in the first quarter of the year, economists said.
"All signs point to the manufacturing sector having a really good head of steam going into the new year," said John Park, economist at Sanwa Securities (USA) Co.
"The report does point out more of the upside risk to the economy that (Federal Reserve Chairman) Alan Greenspan was talking about," he added.
